def evolved_ring_kv(kv_chunks, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                    cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    """Single fused all_gather along chunk dim -> per-slot rows directly."""
    num_slots = len(kv_chunks)
    combined = torch.stack(kv_chunks, dim=0)          # (num_slots, chunk)
    gathered = xm.all_gather(combined, dim=1)         # (num_slots, ws*chunk), rank-ordered
    return [gathered[s] for s in range(num_slots)]
